limits: Read only the three declared input files in full; function-source references and method links were not followed. No browsing, repository/history/source/staging/manifests, memory files, peer outputs or nested review were accessed.

All 27 complete primary declarations, all 540 primary ranks, all contextual declarations and all 269 dictionary entries were read. Each primary rank was considered in its retained leave-on hair-fibre context; footnotes, annotations and formula codes were not promoted to ranked ingredients.

These are committed qualitative whole-formula judgments, not measured retained loads or durability. Exact grades, quantities and finished-film measurements were not supplied; rank was used only as declaration order, never as a quantity or cutoff.

Unassessed functions were not assumed negligible and were not used independently to establish a high conditioning-film claim. Rheology, optical-filter and conditioning-film functions were distinguished.
No weight, fit, penetration, scalp, pre-wash, washout or repeated-accumulation endpoint was assessed. No prior label, ingredient-presence rule or distribution target determined a value.

Schema, complete ID/rank coverage, exact evidence references, dictionary coverage and unchanged input hashes were validated in memory before writing. Only the two assigned lane-b output files were written; neither output was reread.
